comment: Every distinct combination of cartridge header fields found across a real ROM library, with the layout and address resolutions each one produces. Header fields are facts about a cartridge and carry none of its content. Rebuild with record.py against a library you own.

census.comment: A census of a cartridge library: declared layouts, coprocessors, sizes and placements. Header fields are facts about a physical object. No title and no cartridge content is recorded.
